items.q: How do you find and shortlist the right KOLs?
items.a: Search 6,000+ vetted creators across YouTube, TikTok, Twitch, and Bilibili, then let semantic AI matching rank them by fit to your game's genre, audience, and brief — each with a fit score and per-criterion reasoning.

items.q: Is the AI matching accurate, and how do you measure ROI?
items.a: Matching pairs semantic analysis of your brief with each creator's history, so every recommendation carries an explainable fit score. After a campaign, the Insight dashboard tracks plays, engagement, and conversion so you can see what actually worked.

items.q: Is DKIM/SPF/DMARC setup a technical burden?
items.a: None on your side. Email sends from our pre-verified sending domain with DKIM, SPF and DMARC already configured — no DNS or DevOps work for your team.

items.q: Can we customize email templates for our game IP?
items.a: Yes — duplicate any template and adapt the copy, tone, and offer to your game's genre and collaboration stage. The library is organized by game vertical so you start from a relevant base.
